description: Cuisines a place that serves food may name (spec 0.14): what it cooks, by where the food comes from (regional) or by what is served (dish), at most five per business. Each slug has labels in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Dutch, and synonyms; osm are the OpenStreetMap cuisine= values it reads, schemaorg the servesCuisine strings, and overture the Overture place category ids that name it (a place there serves it). A term (a slug with its underscores as spaces, a label, a synonym, a schemaorg string or an osm value) is compared in lower case, without accents, with every run of other characters as one space and the words "and" and "e" left out, and names one entry only. A diet is not a cuisine: vegan and vegetarian named as a cuisine are read as their diet attribute of vocab/attributes.json, and halal and kosher are never cuisines and are never read from one. A reader drops a cuisine named that is not here. A slug is never removed or renamed; new ones come by a change to this file, which raises version.
